environment.note: No stage profiling; a separate parent-side collector samples host counters and other processes once per ten seconds.

method.aggregate: Median of three run means and median of three per-run P99 values; misses and call counts summed.

load_summary.scope: Samples cover visible processes at ten-second intervals; absence of a busy process does not exclude shorter disturbances, host-level scheduling, or frequency changes.

conclusion.scope: Small mean-time improvement is supported for this workload. Deadline misses persist without observed NumCalc contention; individual miss causes remain unresolved.

diagnostic_profile.scope: Cumulative instrumented wall time across threads. TargetFilters includes voice targets and late-decoder targets, so it is not an exclusive fraction of voice work or end-to-end wall time; nested timers are not additive.

limitations: Stage microbenchmarks do not establish full-render capacity or deadline-tail improvements.
No new 30-minute device validation; existing zero-deadline-miss acceptance remains unresolved.

The initial Linux switching median regressed. During the follow-up, six concurrent NumCalc processes each used roughly one core in the same CPU set, and baseline timing rose substantially. Keep all runs; the observation does not establish the cause of individual misses.

The no-NumCalc retest monitors visible processes at ten-second intervals and observes no other process averaging at least 0.15 CPU core, nor cgroup CPU throttling. It does not exclude shorter disturbances, host-level scheduling or frequency variation; it is not a device or long-duration acceptance run.

decision.basis: Repeatable 12.5–17.2% reductions in supported target construction on both platforms; all three longer macOS pairs reduced pose and switching mean times. A subsequent Linux retest without observed NumCalc contention reduced pose and switching median mean times by 1.95% and 1.49%, with all three paired means improving. Numerical and allocation contracts remain verified from the unchanged implementation. Deadline-tail improvement is not established: this retest recorded 43 baseline and 42 candidate misses in 25,326 calls per variant.
